title: Stephen Dick paper on UFOs as cellular-automata-like steering system

tellings.quote: Stephen Dick, who is a NASA adviser, um, wrote a paper about UFOs themselves being part of some sort of, you know, computational almost like cellular automata

plain: Michels says a NASA adviser named Steven J. Dick wrote a paper suggesting UFOs might be part of some kind of computational system, almost like cellular automata, simple computer models where a grid of cells changes by simple rules and builds up complex patterns. Michels does not name the paper or say when it was written; he raises it in a 2025 conversation with the philosopher Jason Jorjani as a sign that respected figures have imagined UFOs as something closer to a program than a vehicle.
